company: SoftBank Robotics (orig. Aldebaran / SoftBank Robotics Europe)
company_native: ソフトバンクロボティクス
target_applications: retail greeting/promotion, reception, care recreation, education

torso_lift.value: fixed torso; 2-DoF hip + 1-DoF knee for bowing/leaning

actuators.value: 20 DC servomotors, position control, no force/torque sensing

end_effector.value: 5-finger cosmetic hands (1 DoF open/close), touch sensors, not load-bearing

sensors_head.value: 4 mics, 2 HD cameras (forehead+mouth), 3D depth sensor (behind eyes), head touch sensors; Pepper+ adds new 2D camera + 3D sensor package

sensors_base.value: 2 sonar, 6 laser line sensors, 3 bumpers, gyroscope; no lidar

compute.value: embedded Atom-class PC in head, NAOqi OS; cloud 'emotion engine'; Wi-Fi a/b/g/n + Ethernet

software_stack.value: NAOqi OS, Choregraphe visual programming, Python/C++ SDK, Android tablet apps; Pepper+ generative-AI sales agent (2026)

safety_compliance.value: CE marked (EU sales); inherently low-risk design; no public ISO 13482 cert

price.value: 2015: ¥198,000 + 36-mo subscription ≈ ¥1.08M 3-yr; Biz ~$440-550/mo; 2026 Pepper+: ¥79,800/mo retail (1-yr min), ¥39,800/mo care, ¥150,000/single month; Home 2.0 ¥43,780/mo

availability.value: Japan rental-only from existing fleet; production halted 06/2021; RobotLAB services US legacy units

deployment_evidence.value: ~27,000 produced / ~17,000 sold, 70 countries; Hamazushi all branches, banks, Pepper PARLOR cafe, Prague & Montreal airports, schools; largest semi-humanoid install base ever

notes: Ownership saga: Aldebaran (2005) -> SoftBank ($100M, 2012) -> United Robotics Group (2022) -> insolvency 02/2025 -> liquidation 06/2025 -> Maxvision (Shenzhen) bought NAO+Pepper IP 2025-07-10 (NAO revived; Pepper plans unclear). SoftBank Robotics Japan continues B2B rentals; 'Pepper+' relaunch 2026-02-02 verified via official page + GIGAZINE. Consumer cloud service ended 2025-02-28 (non-migrated units bricked).
